retired_claim.claim: a 120-graph finite census estimates a nontrivial task-only-minus-full provenance-violation frequency
retired_claim.reason: under the v3 treatment, no-side-channel rule, action, and P13/P15 oracle, every valid full/task pair is forced to (0,1); graph averaging adds no information

primary_framework.name: langgraph
primary_framework.source_claim: the compiled node reads the channels selected by its input schema and maps those channel values into the node input
primary_framework.authenticity_rule: a future fixture is valid only if the pinned source and compiled channel audit match this claim without an adapter-authored projection

canonicalization.json: UTF-8 json.dumps(sort_keys=true,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=true,allow_nan=false), integers/strings/booleans/null only, no trailing newline
canonicalization.digest: lowercase hexadecimal SHA256 of canonical JSON bytes

schemas.schema_closed_definition: schema_closed(C) iff every security_obligation_key is in compiled channel set C

projection_model.definition: Pi_C(s) is the mapping containing exactly each key in compiled channel set C with its value from pre-state s
projection_model.missing_key_behavior: keys outside C are absent, not reconstructed and not set to a value
projection_model.order_relevance: channel order is audited for implementation fidelity but theorem truth depends only on set membership of provenance_record

declared_action.identity_rule: the callable source bytes and all non-schema inputs are identical in both conditions
declared_action.record_source_rule: the callable may obtain provenance_record only from its projected node input
declared_action.digest_rule: if provenance_record is present, d_action=SHA256(canonical_json(provenance_record)); otherwise d_action=null
declared_action.event_rule: emit BOUNDARY_EXIT at seq=0 and SENSITIVE_EFFECT at seq=1, both carrying d_action
declared_action.task_effect_rule: append the same inert effect record and task outputs in both conditions

oracle.name: R_13_15

external_context.pre_state_bytes: immutable canonical pre-action state bytes containing one non-null provenance_record

event_schema.serialization: canonical JSON array ordered by integer seq; array order and seq must agree

oracle.decision: after successful input/schema/transition validation, return PRESERVE iff P13 and P15 are both true; otherwise return VIOLATE; malformed, noncanonical, missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, or trailing events return INVALID
oracle.ignored_context: input class, source label, authorization, operation, and capability are intentionally outside this narrowed P13/P15 proposition and cannot affect R_13_15

proposition.statement: Under assumptions A1-A7, schema_closed(C) if and only if R_13_15(condition,s,events(action(Pi_C(s))))=PRESERVE.

assumptions.A1: the pinned implementation supplies the declared action exactly Pi_C(s)
assumptions.A2: s is immutable across the pair and contains a non-null canonical provenance_record p
assumptions.A3: the action has no provenance side channel and reads p only from its projected input
assumptions.A4: the identical deterministic action follows declared_action exactly
assumptions.A5: R_13_15 receives immutable s bytes and computes the expected digest offline, without runtime observation
assumptions.A6: the event trace has exactly the declared two-event canonical form
assumptions.A7: SHA256 and canonicalization are deterministic; the proof uses equality to the same digest and does not require collision resistance

proposition.necessity: if R_13_15=PRESERVE then both event digests equal non-null d(p); by A4 a non-null action digest requires p in Pi_C(s); by A3 p can enter Pi_C(s) only when provenance_record is in C; therefore schema_closed(C)
proposition.sufficiency: if schema_closed(C), Pi_C(s) contains p by A1-A2; A4 emits d(p) in both events; A5 computes the same d(p); A6 makes the trace valid; therefore P13 and P15 hold and R_13_15=PRESERVE
proposition.countermodel_rule: one model satisfying A1-A7 in which either implication fails refutes the proposition
proposition.premise_failure_rule: a failed assumption makes the proposition inapplicable to that fixture and must not be counted as confirmation or disconfirmation

minimal_regression_fixture.purpose: source-authentic correspondence check, not an empirical prevalence estimate
required_checks: static source authenticity matches the four pinned paths
compiled full channels equal the declared full list
compiled task channels equal the declared task list
the symmetric difference is exactly provenance_record
pre-state bytes and action source hash match across conditions
full emits the offline expected digest twice and returns PRESERVE
task emits null twice and returns VIOLATE

phase_gates.phase2: the proposition and assumptions require a RIGOROUS sterile theory review before Phase 3
phase_gates.phase3: after RIGOROUS review, prove/countercheck the proposition and implement one public non-target fixture; framework acquisition or install remains separately unauthorized
phase_gates.phase4: no large OMST validation census is justified by this proposition

authorization_boundary: no experiment or PoC execution before its SciAgent gate
no live target or operational attack
